purpose: User-fixed point-cloud settings, separate from the immutable E2 shape recipe
point_count_policy: Derived from model surface and spacing; do not downsample the preserved 537418-point cloud to 350000
layer_sampling: Sample existing triangles densely, snap XYZ to an exact 0.08 x 0.08 x 0.09 mm lattice, and keep one point per occupied cell. Source mesh is unchanged.
applies_at: Stored physical model size; resample after any future physical resizing
